decision_scope: Cohort-level retention planning and workforce policy evaluation
allowed_uses: Compare aggregate workforce signals across sufficiently large groups
Monitor intervention outcomes and distributional effects
Prepare questions for qualified HR, privacy and employment-law review
prohibited_uses: Make or recommend termination, promotion, compensation or discipline decisions about a person
Expose, export or rank named employees by predicted flight risk
Treat a non-significant disparity as evidence that no fairness risk exists
Claim the synthetic intervention uplift is causal
Use a protected attribute as a model feature or decision rule
Publish a slice below the minimum group size
monitoring_cadence: Monthly during pilot; quarterly after controlled release
